review: Independent visual review of release 1.1 PDFs

delegated_review.scope: main.pdf physical pages 95-118; every page inspected

documents.coverage: All new visual chapters, release status, extension references, appendix map, and appendices F-J; opening material and selected inherited pages also reviewed.
Every page, including all fourteen computed plates.

method: Read the PDF skill and performed read-only review without editing manuscript sources.
Rendered PDF pages with Poppler pdftoppm at 90 or 100 DPI; visually inspected contact sheets and individual pages.
Inspected equations, table wrapping, chart labels, geometry/inverse plates 07 and 08, margins, running headers, footers, and page balance.

After final edits, re-rendered all inspected pages from copied final PDFs. Pixel comparison confirmed that other pages were unchanged from the inspected render; every changed page was inspected separately.
Verified final PDF hashes were unchanged during the final render-and-compare procedure.

resolved_during_review: Root repaired a pre-existing inline-formula overflow on physical main page 9; the final displayed limit fits cleanly.
The preserved 1.0 status pages now carry explicit baseline headings and clarify that the eighteen-figure description refers to the preserved baseline.
The appendix map now includes F-J and distinguishes the 1.0 and 1.1 review scopes.
The scalar family used by the component reduction is now defined on the visual reduction page; the additional text fits in both publications.
findings.nonblocking_editorial_observation: Appendix I repeats an omitted-figure cross-reference sentence on physical page 115. It is readable and does not impair the argument or layout.

limits: This is a visual and layout review, not a new mathematical audit. Inherited main pages outside the listed sample were not visually re-audited.
